desc: Key Applications: Web Server, Cloud Computing, Value IaaS, Data Center, Content Delivery Network (CDN), DNS & Gateway Server, Edge Node, Firewall
Single Socket AMD EPYC™ 9006 SP7 Series Processor up to 256 cores
Supports up to 5 PCIe 6.0 x16 slots
Flexible networking with 1 AIOM slot (OCP 3.0 SFF compliant)
Modular front drive bay design supporting up to 16 U.2/E3.S or 12 E1.S hot-swappable NVMe drives
Dual Redundant Titanium Level power supplies (Power supply full redundancy based on configuration and application load)
